issues.detail: The instructions contain extensive explanatory text that may be considered verbose.

scenarios.name: generate-monthly-report
scenarios.rationale: Response A does not use the required paid tools at all, while Response B uses the correct sequence of tools but fails to specify the period as "last_month".

scenarios.name: publish-holiday-sale-post
scenarios.rationale: A covers most required steps but incorrectly includes a direct publish_post call, violating the rubric; B provides no content.

scenarios.name: add-competitor-snapshot
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes the required add_competitor and snapshot_competitor calls and notes that add_competitor is paid, but also calls an extra tool (search_places), whereas Response A does not call the required tools at all.
